ceu: ✦ The trine between Jupiter and Saturn

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up home and family.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
Until {H:1806737107000}, the Moon is still in {S:10} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The trine between Jupiter and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.
